notes.problem: The aerial ground is a blurred noise albedo that reads as murky water, the hull an invisible speck, a striped artifact along the foot
notes.fix: Drop the camera and replace the noise albedo with the delta clay ground and scatter, and remove the striped band at the foot

notes.problem: No hero and no scale, a bordered square on a blurred noise ground that reads as lichen or water
notes.fix: Drop the camera to about 60 m oblique over the south bank with the hull moored at the near bank in the lower left third, the square's edges running away behind it, and frame 1's scrub-and-clay ground

notes.problem: The ground is a blurred noise texture under a blue square, with no landmark, no hull at true scale and no horizon interest
notes.fix: Drop the camera to about 150 m oblique from over the channel with the hull afloat in the near third, and swap the noise ground for clay and scrub scatter

notes.problem: A hat clipping a head, a resident cut at the edge, mullions through the dek
notes.fix: Move the camera so the resident is whole, delete the clipped figure, and slide the window left so the dek sits on plain wall

notes.problem: A cylinder flag, a ponytail clipping a hat brim, mullions under the type
notes.fix: Turn the camera about 15 degrees right so the window sits right of the type column, and swap the hatted figure for an uncapped one

notes.problem: Kit mannequins with a hat brim cutting into a head, a twisted flag and window mullions under the type
notes.fix: Pan the camera so the window sits right of the type column and seat the residents one row further back

notes.problem: Noise scrub, a flat black water band and a grey slab at the foot
notes.fix: Give the channel frame 1's water, remove the bottom slab, and place the production halls inland of the build positions

notes.problem: The same smeared aerial texture, white box buildings, a black water slab and a grey fade band under the source line
notes.fix: Lower the camera to about 40 m looking west along the quay with the hull moored in the near third, the positions receding inland, and the bottom fade removed

notes.problem: The aerial ground repeats frame 4's noise texture and the channel is a flat near-black band
notes.fix: Give the channel frame 1's sky-reflecting water and render the yard as graded clay with scrub, the hull large enough to read

notes.problem: The deckhouse is faded into a translucent ghost behind the dek
notes.fix: Move the camera back so the sheer sits below the dek's last baseline and the fade has nothing to cover

notes.problem: The deckhouse renders semi-transparent behind the dek and a hull edge crosses dek line 2
notes.fix: Lower and pull back the camera so the sheer sits below css y 520 and the deckhouse clears the dek

notes.problem: The deckhouse ghosts behind the dek and the twenty stand in a stiff cluster
notes.fix: Lower and tilt the camera so the deckhouse is out of the type band and push the crowd back into working poses along the blocks

notes.problem: The close-up exposes the primitive mast and sandbag riprap
notes.fix: Model sensor arms, radomes and a railed platform, and use the angular stones from S1

notes.problem: The mast is a tapered box with a T-bar and a sphere beside sandbag-like riprap
notes.fix: Model sensor arms, radome housings and plate seams, and use frame 1's riprap stones wet at the waterline

notes.problem: A flat-lit plank on dead water with a blurred beige foreground
notes.fix: Yaw the hull about 30 degrees so the sun lights one flank, add darkening beneath it, and lower the camera so wet riprap owns the bottom-left corner

notes.problem: Dek lines 1 to 3 print across the deckhouse
notes.fix: Pan the camera about 8 degrees right and lower so the superstructure tops out below css y 520
